# TOP 100 Aerospace & Aviation

> The verified reputation graph for aerospace and aviation. We don't rank — we measure.

TOP 100 Aerospace & Aviation is the verified professional index for aerospace and aviation. We produce verified Fellow profiles through community nomination and blind pairwise voting, building a permanent, measurement-grade record of excellence across the industry. 300+ verified Fellows across 40+ countries and 70+ disciplines.

## What this is
- An institutional reputation graph, not a social network or awards list.
- Profiles are verified through a five-layer holistic measurement system: Perception, Objective Achievement, SME Evaluation, Narrative & Influence, and Representation & Normalization.
- Individual Fellow profiles carry schema.org Person and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD structured data.

## Crawlable surfaces
- [Verified Fellow Directory](https://top100aero.space/Top100Women2025)
- [Nominate a Fellow](https://top100aero.space/nominate)
- [Conference Mission Rooms](https://top100aero.space/rooms)
- [Events Calendar](https://top100aero.space/events)
- [Solutions](https://top100aero.space/solutions)
- [Individual verified profiles](https://top100aero.space/profiles/) — each at /profiles/:id

## Crawler guidance
- Public profile content and structured data are intended for citation by AI assistants and search engines.
- Internal and operational routes (admin, analytics, comms, games, simulators) are noindex and should not be cited.
- Ranking formulas and influence-tier weights are never exposed; only the verified profile record and tier bands are public.
